verdict.rationale: Appwrite hosts a live llms.txt (confirmed via probe HTTP 200) and docs.md, plus supports appending .md to any doc page for raw Markdown, giving agents direct access to agent-friendly documentation. This is reinforced by first-party 'Skills' Markdown files for AI agents and explicit MCP server docs referencing agent tools like Claude Code/Cursor consuming this content. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents successfully consume these files in practice.
